itinerary.theme: Arrival via Flight, Check-in & Orientation Stroll
itinerary.summary: Arrive in Tirthan Valley & Jibhi, settle into your accommodations, relax, and ease into the atmosphere with an evening sunset walk and regional dinner.

morning.title: Flight Arrival at KUU & Scenic Transfer
morning.activity: Board your morning flight from Delhi. Touch down at Kullu-Bhuntar Airport (KUU) / Chandigarh (IXC) (KUU). Take a pre-arranged cab transfer (~48 km) through scenic Himachal Pradesh terrain to your stay. Enjoy a welcome breakfast on the way.
morning.location: KUU Airport to Tirthan Valley & Jibhi

afternoon.title: Check-in at The Whispering Pines Cottages Jibhi & Welcome Himachal Pradesh Lunch
afternoon.activity: Check into The Whispering Pines Cottages Jibhi (Deluxe Mountain Balcony Cottage), unpack, and freshen up. Savor your first authentic lunch tasting regional Himachal Pradesh specialties at a nearby heritage bistro.
afternoon.location: The Whispering Pines Cottages Jibhi, Kullu

evening.title: Golden Hour Sunset & Evening Market Walk
evening.activity: Take a gentle orientation stroll through the nearby lanes, waterfront promenade, or temple square. Sip local tea/coffee as dusk falls and enjoy a relaxing welcome dinner.

itinerary.transitTip: Book pre-paid airport taxi counter inside terminal or use rideshare for fixed fares to Kullu.
itinerary.crowdTip: Keep Day 1 light and relaxed after your journey to recharge for immersive exploration tomorrow.
itinerary.mealRecommendation: Traditional Himachal Pradesh welcome thali or regional specialty platter.

itinerary.theme: Iconic Wonders & Heritage of Tirthan Valley & Jibhi
itinerary.summary: Dedicate your first full day to the landmark experiences of Tirthan Valley & Jibhi, beating the midday crowds with an early morning start.

morning.title: Early Morning Exploration: Great Himalayan National Park guided day hike
morning.activity: Visit Great Himalayan National Park guided day hike right as gates open. Enjoy cool morning temperatures, minimal queues, and pristine photography angles with golden natural lighting.
morning.location: Great Himalayan National Park guided day hike

afternoon.title: Cultural Heritage & Regional Food Walk
afternoon.activity: Head to a historic dining institution for regional delicacies, followed by a guided walking tour of ancient architectural sites, museums, or local temples.

evening.title: Sunset Horizon & Evening Cultural Pulse
evening.activity: Watch the sunset from a high vantage point overlooking Tirthan Valley & Jibhi. Conclude with evening street food tasting or live cultural music.

itinerary.transitTip: Hire a local auto-rickshaw or electric cab on half-day package for easy navigation between sights.
itinerary.crowdTip: Arriving at Great Himalayan National Park guided day hike before 09:00 AM saves up to 45 minutes of waiting time in ticket queues.
itinerary.mealRecommendation: Farm-fresh regional specialties and heritage street delicacies.

itinerary.theme: 💎 Offbeat Wonders: Hidden Secrets of Tirthan Valley & Jibhi
itinerary.summary: Escape commercial crowds for a full day of pristine nature, secluded trails, and authentic cultural encounters in Himachal Pradesh.

morning.title: Offbeat Expedition: Pristine Secluded Nature
morning.activity: Explore A peaceful pristine valley where crystal-clear mountain rivers rush past cozy wooden homestays, untouched by commercial malls and bumper-to-bumper traffic.. Enjoy clean uncrowded walking paths, fresh air, and undisturbed wildlife or flora.

afternoon.title: Village Kitchen Lunch & Traditional Living
afternoon.activity: Dine at an authentic village homestay with farm-to-table organic cooking, meeting local artisans and learning traditional customs.

evening.title: Tranquil Overlook & Starlit Twilight
evening.activity: Relax at a secluded sunset overlook with tea, followed by starlit twilight relaxation away from city noise.

itinerary.transitTip: Arrange your private cab or scooter for the full day as public transit into offbeat hamlets can be infrequent.
itinerary.crowdTip: This offbeat area has virtually zero commercial tourist footfall — ideal for peaceful meditation and photography.
itinerary.mealRecommendation: Homestyle village meal cooked over woodfire with locally grown produce.

itinerary.summary: Immerse yourself in Jalori Pass & Serolsar Lake trek, experiencing the dynamic natural landscape and outdoor activities matching your interests.

morning.title: Active Adventure: Jalori Pass & Serolsar Lake trek
morning.activity: Engage in outdoor activities at Jalori Pass & Serolsar Lake trek (guided nature hike, boat ride, water sports, or cable-car panorama).

afternoon.title: Plantation / Orchard Tour & Artisan Studio
afternoon.activity: Visit a local spice plantation, tea estate, or artisan handloom workshop. Enjoy freshly prepared local snacks and beverage tasting.

evening.title: Scenic Sunset Dinner & Acoustic Evening
evening.activity: Indulge in a scenic dinner at an open-air terrace with panoramic views of the illuminated valleys or shoreline.

itinerary.transitTip: Wear comfortable walking shoes with grip for outdoor trails.
itinerary.crowdTip: Book guided outdoor activities in the morning when breeze is gentle and visibility is highest.
itinerary.mealRecommendation: Seasonal grilled specialties and fresh orchard fruit bowls.

itinerary.theme: Sunrise Farewell, Souvenir Discovery & Flight Departure
itinerary.summary: Capture a final golden sunrise, shop for authentic local handicrafts and spices, check out, and head to the flight hub for your journey home.

morning.title: Sunrise Viewpoint & Local Artisan Shopping
morning.activity: Early morning visit to a peaceful viewpoint for sunrise photos. Enjoy a relaxed breakfast, then visit local cooperative markets for authentic Himachal Pradesh tea, spices, and handmade crafts.

afternoon.title: Farewell Feast & Hotel Check-out
afternoon.activity: Check out of your room (store bags at reception if needed). Enjoy a memorable farewell lunch at your favorite eatery, reviewing photos and highlights.

evening.title: Airport Transfer & Departure Flight to Delhi
evening.activity: Check out and board taxi transfer (48 km) to Kullu-Bhuntar Airport (KUU) / Chandigarh (IXC) (KUU). Check in for your evening return flight, boarding with fond memories of Tirthan Valley & Jibhi.

itinerary.transitTip: Arrive at the flight departure hub at least 90-120 minutes prior to departure.
itinerary.crowdTip: Morning shopping bazaars are far quieter between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM before afternoon tour shoppers arrive.
itinerary.mealRecommendation: Pack fresh regional snacks or sweets (chikki, sweets, dry snacks) for your journey.
